name: openclaw-dedicated
description: Repositório dedicado para OpenClaw - integração e desenvolvimento

scripts.install:modules: for dir in openclaw-core clawhub lobster integrations/*/; do cd $dir && npm install && cd ../..; done
scripts.test:all: for dir in openclaw-core clawhub lobster integrations/*/; do cd $dir && npm test && cd ../..; done
scripts.build:all: for dir in openclaw-core clawhub lobster integrations/*/; do cd $dir && npm run build && cd ../..; done
